// PACK 03_meh  files=36

// ===== 03_meh/Meh_baddypack/baddywar__000__26_9.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: Meh/baddypack/baddywar.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 26 9
// image: -
// tile: 26,9
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: b1a4f765774f

NPC - 26 9
// NPC made by Ace2896
function Initialize(){
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #n,GoodBow;
  shieldpower=0;
  setcharprop #2,blankbow.png;
  setcharprop #3,head495.png;
  setcharprop #C0,gray;
  setcharprop #C1,gray;
  setcharprop #C2,black;
  setcharprop #C3,gray;
  setcharprop #C4,black;
  hearts=10;
  this.speed=.4;
  swordpower=1;
  this.radius=1.5;
  this.keepdist=16;
  this.closedist=3;
  timeout=.05;
}
function Convert(){
  this.curdist=64;
  for (i=0;i<compuscount;i++){
    if (!compus[i].mode==9&&!compus[i].mode==5){
      this.distx=abs(compus[i].x-x);
      this.disty=abs(compus[i].y-y);
      this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
      if (this.dist<this.curdist){
        this.curdist=this.dist;
        this.index=i;
      }
    }
  }
  this.testx=compus[this.index].x;
  this.testy=compus[this.index].y;
}
function SwordAttack(){
  if (sprite<13)sprite++;
  else {
    sprite=0;
    this.mode=0;
  }
}
function GetDist(){
  Convert();
  this.distx=abs(this.testx-x);
  this.disty=abs(this.testy-y);
  this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
}
function Direction(){
  GetDist();
  if (this.distx<=this.disty){
    if (this.testy<y)dir=0;
    if (this.testy>y)dir=2;
  }else{
    if (this.testx<x)dir=1;
    if (this.testx>x)dir=3;
  }
}
function BounceBack(){
  Convert();
  this.hit=0;
  while(this.hit<5){
    sprite=39;
    this.hit+=.5;
    if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x+3.5,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x-.5,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3.5)) y+=.5;
    if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+.5)) y-=.5;
    sleep .05;
  }
  sprite=0;
  timeout=.05;
}
function SpinMove(){
  sprite=0;
  while(d<=8){
    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;
    sleep .1;
  }
  sprite=40;
  for (i=0;i<this.aout+4;i++)deletestring trackaxyt,i;
}
function ShootBow(){
  if (this.shoot<10)this.shoot++;
  else {
    this.shoot=0;
    this.mode=0;
  }
  if (this.shoot==5){
    shootarrow dir;
    sprite=0;
  }
}
function Aim(){
  sprite=(sprite%8)+1;
  GetDist();
  if (this.distx<this.disty){
    if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x+3+this.speed,y+1.5)){
      x+=this.speed;
      dir=3;
    }
    if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x-this.speed,y+1.5)){
      x-=this.speed;
      dir=1;
    }
  }else{
    if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.speed)){
      y+=this.speed;
      dir=2;
    }
    if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y-this.speed)){
      y-=this.speed;
      dir=0;
    }
  }
  if (this.dist<=this.keepdist){
    if (this.distx<this.disty){
      if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+1-(this.speed/2)))y-=(this.speed/2);
      if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+(this.speed/2)))y+=(this.speed/2);
    }
    if (this.disty<this.distx){
      if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x-(this.speed/2),y+1.5))x-=(this.speed/2);
      if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x+3+(this.speed/2),y+1.5))x+=(this.speed/2);
    }
  }
  if((x-this.testx<1&&this.testx-x<1)||(y-this.testy<1&&this.testy-y<1)){
    this.mode=1;
    Direction();
    setcharani shoot.gani,wbow1.png;
  }
  if (this.dist<=this.closedist){
    this.mode=2;
    sprite=9;
  }
}
function ShootBaddy(){
  for (i=0;i<arrowscount;i++){
    c=testcompu(arrows[i].x,arrows[i].y);
    if (c>=0&&!compus[c].mode==5&&!compus[c].mode==9){
      hitcompu c,swordpower,arrows[i].x,arrows[i].y;
      removearrow i;
    }
  }
}
if (playerenters){
  Initialize();
}
if (timeout&&(compuscount>0||this.aout>0)){
  ShootBaddy();
  if (this.mode==0)Aim();
  else if (this.mode==1) ShootBow();
  else if (this.mode==2) SwordAttack();
  if (hearts>0) timeout=.05;
  else SpinMove();
}else{
  this.mode=0;
  sprite=0;
}
if ((washit||waspelt||exploded||wasshot)&&hearts>0){
  hearts-=playerswordpower;
  this.shoot=0;
  this.mode=0;
  BounceBack();
}

NPCEND

// ===== 03_meh/Meh_baddypack/baddywar__001__35_9.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: Meh/baddypack/baddywar.nw
// npc-index: 1
// header: NPC - 35 9
// image: -
// tile: 35,9
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 7533ec787fd5

NPC - 35 9
// NPC made by Ace2896
function Initialize(){
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #n,GoodSword;
  setcharprop #2,shield2.png;
  setcharprop #1,sword2.png;
  setcharprop #3,head495.png;
  setcharprop #C0,gray;
  setcharprop #C1,gray;
  setcharprop #C2,black;
  setcharprop #C3,gray;
  setcharprop #C4,black;
  hearts=10;
  this.speed=.5;
  swordpower=2;
  this.radius=1.5;
  this.attackdist=3;
  timeout=.05;
}
function Convert(){
  this.curdist=64;
  for (i=0;i<compuscount;i++){
    if (!compus[i].mode==5||!compus[i].mode==9){
      this.distx=abs(compus[i].x-x);
      this.disty=abs(compus[i].y-y);
      this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
      if (this.dist<this.curdist){
        this.curdist=this.dist;
        this.index=i;
      }
    }
  }
  this.testx=compus[this.index].x;
  this.testy=compus[this.index].y;
}
function GetDist(){
  Convert();
  this.distx=abs(this.testx-x);
  this.disty=abs(this.testy-y);
  this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
}
function Direction(){
  GetDist();
  if (this.distx<=this.disty){
    if (this.testy<y)dir=0;
    if (this.testy>y)dir=2;
  }else{
    if (this.testx<x)dir=1;
    if (this.testx>x)dir=3;
  }
}
function MoveCheck(){
  if (this.distx<=.5)this.addy=this.speed;
  else if (this.disty<=.5)this.addx=this.speed;
  else if (this.distx>this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.disty/this.distx;
    this.addx=this.speed;
    this.addy=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }else if (this.disty>this.distx){
    this.ratio=this.distx/this.disty;
    this.addy=this.speed;
    this.addx=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }
}
function Movement(){
  Direction();
  MoveCheck();
  sprite=(sprite%8)+1;
  if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.addy)) y+=this.addy;
  if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+1-this.addy)) y-=this.addy;
  if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x+3+this.addx,y+1.5)) x+=this.addx;
  if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x-this.addx,y+1.5)) x-=this.addx;
}
function BounceBack(){
  Convert();
  this.hit=0;
  while(this.hit<5){
    sprite=39;
    this.hit+=.5;
    if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x+3.5,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x-.5,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3.5)) y+=.5;
    if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+.5)) y-=.5;
    sleep .05;
  }
  sprite=0;
  timeout=.05;
}
function SpinMove(){
  sprite=0;
  while(d<=8){
    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;
    sleep .1;
  }
  sprite=40;
}
function AttackCheck(){
  GetDist();
  if (this.dist<=this.attackdist){
    this.attack=1;
    sprite=9;
  }
}
function HitCheck(){
  t=testcompu(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (t>=0)hitcompu t,swordpower,this.testx,this.testy;
  t=testplayer(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (t>=0)hitplayer t,swordpower,this.testx,this.testy;
}
function RadialHitDetection(){
  AttackCheck();
  for (this.angle=0;this.count<20;this.angle+=.314){
    this.testx=x+1+cos(this.angle)*this.radius;
    this.testy=y+1.3+sin(this.angle)*this.radius;
    this.count++;
    HitCheck();
  }
  this.count=0;
}
function SwordAttack(){
  if (sprite<13)sprite++;
  else {
    sprite=0;
    this.attack=0;
  }
}
if (playerenters){
  Initialize();
}
if (timeout&&compuscount>0){
  if (this.attack==0){
    Movement();
    RadialHitDetection();
  }else if (this.attack==1)SwordAttack();
  if (hearts>0) timeout=.05;
  else SpinMove();
}
if ((washit||waspelt||exploded||wasshot)&&hearts>0){
  this.attack=0;
  hearts-=playerswordpower;
  BounceBack();
}

NPCEND

NPC - 34 55
// NPC made by Ace2896
function Initialize(){
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #n,BadBow;
  shieldpower=0;
  setcharprop #2,blankbow.png;
  hearts=10;
  this.speed=.4;
  swordpower=3;
  this.radius=1.5;
  this.keepdist=16;
  this.closedist=3;
  timeout=.05;
}
function Convert(){
  this.testx=playerx;
  this.testy=playery;
}
function GetDist(){
  Convert();
  this.distx=abs(this.testx-x);
  this.disty=abs(this.testy-y);
  this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
}
function Direction(){
  GetDist();
  if (this.distx<=this.disty){
    if (this.testy<y)dir=0;
    if (this.testy>y)dir=2;
  }else{
    if (this.testx<x)dir=1;
    if (this.testx>x)dir=3;
  }
}
function BounceBack(){
  Convert();
  this.hit=0;
  while(this.hit<5){
    sprite=39;
    this.hit+=.5;
    if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x+3.5,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x-.5,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3.5)) y+=.5;
    if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+.5)) y-=.5;
    sleep .05;
  }
  sprite=0;
  timeout=.05;
}
function SpinMove(){
  sprite=0;
  while(d<=8){
    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;
    sleep .1;
  }
  sprite=40;
}
function ShootBow(){
  if (this.shoot<10)this.shoot++;
  else {
    this.shoot=0;
    this.mode=0;
  }
  if (this.shoot==5){
    shootarrow dir;
    sprite=0;
  }
}
function Aim(){
  sprite=(sprite%8)+1;
  GetDist();
  if (this.distx<this.disty){
    if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x+3+this.speed,y+1.5)){
      x+=this.speed;
      dir=3;
    }
    if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x-this.speed,y+1.5)){
      x-=this.speed;
      dir=1;
    }
  }else{
    if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.speed)){
      y+=this.speed;
      dir=2;
    }
    if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y-this.speed)){
      y-=this.speed;
      dir=0;
    }
  }
  if (this.dist<=this.keepdist){
    if (this.distx<this.disty){
      if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+1-(this.speed/2)))y-=(this.speed/2);
      if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+(this.speed/2)))y+=(this.speed/2);
    }
    if (this.disty<this.distx){
      if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x-(this.speed/2),y+1.5))x-=(this.speed/2);
      if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x+3+(this.speed/2),y+1.5))x+=(this.speed/2);
    }
  }
  if((x-this.testx<1&&this.testx-x<1)||(y-this.testy<1&&this.testy-y<1)){
    this.mode=1;
    Direction();
    sprite=33;
  }
  if (this.dist<=this.closedist){
    this.mode=2;
    sprite=9;
  }
}
function SwordAttack(){
  if (sprite<13)sprite++;
  else {
    sprite=0;
    this.mode=0;
  }
}
if (playerenters){
  Initialize();
}
if (timeout){
  if (this.mode==0)Aim();
  else if (this.mode==1) ShootBow();
  else if (this.mode==2) SwordAttack();
  if (hearts>0) timeout=.05;
  else SpinMove();
}
if ((washit||waspelt||exploded||wasshot)&&hearts>0){
  hearts-=playerswordpower;
  this.shoot=0;
  this.mode=0;
  BounceBack();
}

NPC - 4 32

function Initialize(){
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #n,NPCBow;
  shieldpower=0;
  setcharprop #2,blankbow.png;
  setcharprop #3,head9.png;
  setcharprop #C0,darkpurple;
  setcharprop #C1,darkblue;
  setcharprop #C2,white;
  setcharprop #C3,darkpurple;
  setcharprop #C4,white;
  hearts=10;
  this.speed=.4;
  swordpower=1;
  this.radius=1.5;
  this.keepdist=16;
  this.closedist=3;
  timeout=.05;
}
function Convert(){
  this.curdist=64;
  for (i=0;i<npcscount;i++){
    if (npcs[i].hearts>0&&!npcs[i].id==id){
      this.distx=abs(npcs[i].x-x);
      this.disty=abs(npcs[i].y-y);
      this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
      if (this.dist<this.curdist){
        this.curdist=this.dist;
        this.index=i;
      }
    }
  }
  this.testx=npcs[this.index].x;
  this.testy=npcs[this.index].y;
}
function SwordAttack(){
  if (sprite<13)sprite++;
  else {
    sprite=0;
    this.mode=0;
  }
}
function GetDist(){
  Convert();
  this.distx=abs(this.testx-x);
  this.disty=abs(this.testy-y);
  this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
}
function Direction(){
  GetDist();
  if (this.distx<=this.disty){
    if (this.testy<y)dir=0;
    if (this.testy>y)dir=2;
  }else{
    if (this.testx<x)dir=1;
    if (this.testx>x)dir=3;
  }
}
function BounceBack(){
  Convert();
  this.hit=0;
  while(this.hit<5){
    sprite=39;
    this.hit+=.5;
    if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x+3.5,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x-.5,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3.5)) y+=.5;
    if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+.5)) y-=.5;
    sleep .05;
  }
  sprite=0;
  timeout=.05;
}
function SpinMove(){
  sprite=0;
  while(d<=8){
    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;
    sleep .1;
  }
  sprite=40;
}
function ShootBow(){
  if (this.shoot<10)this.shoot++;
  else {
    this.shoot=0;
    this.mode=0;
  }
  if (this.shoot==5){
    shootarrow dir;
    sprite=0;
  }

function Aim(){
  sprite=(sprite%8)+1;
  GetDist();
  if (this.distx<this.disty){
    if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x+3+this.speed,y+1.5)){
      x+=this.speed;
      dir=3;
    }
    if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x-this.speed,y+1.5)){
      x-=this.speed;
      dir=1;
    }
  }else{
    if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.speed)){
      y+=this.speed;
      dir=2;
    }
    if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y-this.speed)){
      y-=this.speed;
      dir=0;
    }
  }
  if (this.dist<=this.keepdist){
    if (this.distx<this.disty){
      if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+1-(this.speed/2)))y-=(this.speed/2);
      if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+(this.speed/2)))y+=(this.speed/2);
    }
    if (this.disty<this.distx){
      if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x-(this.speed/2),y+1.5))x-=(this.speed/2);
      if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x+3+(this.speed/2),y+1.5))x+=(this.speed/2);
    }
  }
  if((x-this.testx<1&&this.testx-x<1)||(y-this.testy<1&&this.testy-y<1)){
    this.mode=1;
    Direction();
    setcharani shoot.gani,wbow1.png;
  }
  if (this.dist<=this.closedist){
    this.mode=2;
    sprite=9;
  }
}
if (playerenters){
  Initialize();
}
if (timeout){
  if (this.mode==0)Aim();
  else if (this.mode==1) ShootBow();
  else if (this.mode==2) SwordAttack();
  if (hearts>0) timeout=.05;
  else SpinMove();
}else{
  this.mode=0;
  sprite=0;
}
if ((washit||waspelt||exploded||wasshot)&&hearts>0){
  hearts-=playerswordpower;
  this.shoot=0;
  this.mode=0;
  BounceBack();
}

// ===== 03_meh/Meh_baddypack/baddywar__006__55_32.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: Meh/baddypack/baddywar.nw
// npc-index: 6
// header: NPC - 55 32
// image: -
// tile: 55,32
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: f386e91f1b1f

NPC - 55 32
// NPC made by Ace2896
function Initialize(){
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #n,NPCSword;
  setcharprop #2,shield2.png;
  setcharprop #1,sword2.png;
  setcharprop #3,head9.png;
  setcharprop #C0,darkpurple;
  setcharprop #C1,darkblue;
  setcharprop #C2,white;
  setcharprop #C3,darkpurple;
  setcharprop #C4,white;
  hearts=10;
  this.speed=.5;
  swordpower=2;
  this.radius=1.5;
  this.attackdist=3;
  timeout=.05;
}
function Convert(){
  this.curdist=64;
  for (i=0;i<npcscount;i++){
    if (npcs[i].hearts>0&&!npcs[i].id==id){
      this.distx=abs(npcs[i].x-x);
      this.disty=abs(npcs[i].y-y);
      this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
      if (this.dist<this.curdist){
        this.curdist=this.dist;
        this.index=i;
      }
    }
  }
  this.testx=npcs[this.index].x;
  this.testy=npcs[this.index].y;
}
function GetDist(){
  Convert();
  this.distx=abs(this.testx-x);
  this.disty=abs(this.testy-y);
  this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
}
function Direction(){
  GetDist();
  if (this.distx<=this.disty){
    if (this.testy<y)dir=0;
    if (this.testy>y)dir=2;
  }else{
    if (this.testx<x)dir=1;
    if (this.testx>x)dir=3;
  }
}
function MoveCheck(){
  if (this.distx<=.5)this.addy=this.speed;
  else if (this.disty<=.5)this.addx=this.speed;
  else if (this.distx>this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.disty/this.distx;
    this.addx=this.speed;
    this.addy=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }else if (this.disty>this.distx){
    this.ratio=this.distx/this.disty;
    this.addy=this.speed;
    this.addx=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }
}
function Movement(){
  Direction();
  MoveCheck();
  sprite=(sprite%8)+1;
  if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.addy)) y+=this.addy;
  if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+1-this.addy)) y-=this.addy;
  if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x+3+this.addx,y+1.5)) x+=this.addx;
  if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x-this.addx,y+1.5)) x-=this.addx;
}
function BounceBack(){
  Convert();
  this.hit=0;
  while(this.hit<5){
    sprite=39;
    this.hit+=.5;
    if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x+3.5,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x-.5,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3.5)) y+=.5;
    if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+.5)) y-=.5;
    sleep .05;
  }
  sprite=0;
  timeout=.05;
}
function SpinMove(){
  sprite=0;
  while(d<=8){
    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;
    sleep .1;
  }
  sprite=40;
}
function AttackCheck(){
  GetDist();
  if (this.dist<=this.attackdist){
    this.attack=1;
    sprite=9;
  }
}
function HitCheck(){
  t=testcompu(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (t>=0)hitcompu t,swordpower,this.testx,this.testy;
  t=testplayer(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (t>=0)hitplayer t,swordpower,this.testx,this.testy;
}
function RadialHitDetection(){
  AttackCheck();
  for (this.angle=0;this.count<20;this.angle+=.314){
    this.testx=x+1+cos(this.angle)*this.radius;
    this.testy=y+1.3+sin(this.angle)*this.radius;
    this.count++;
    HitCheck();
  }
  this.count=0;
}
function SwordAttack(){
  if (sprite<13)sprite++;
  else {
    sprite=0;
    this.attack=0;
  }
}
if (playerenters){
  Initialize();
}
if (timeout){
  if (this.attack==0){
    Movement();
    RadialHitDetection();
  }else if (this.attack==1)SwordAttack();
  if (hearts>0) timeout=.05;
  else SpinMove();
}
if ((washit||waspelt||exploded||wasshot)&&hearts>0){
  this.attack=0;
  hearts-=playerswordpower;
  BounceBack();
}

timereverywhere;
function SpriteAssign(){
  if (this.carry!=1){
    sprite=(sprite%8)+1;
  }else if (this.carry==1){
    if (sprite<32){
      sprite++;
    }else{
      sprite=25;
    }
  }
}
function GetDist(){
  this.distx=abs(playerx-x);
  this.disty=abs(playery-y);
  this.distance=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
}
function Throw(){
  throwcarry;
  this.carry=0;
}
function Catch(){
  this.carry=1;
  sprite=24;
  if (peltwithbush) carryobject bush;
  else if (peltwithsign) carryobject sign;
  else if (peltwithvase) carryobject vase;
  else if (peltwithstone) carryobject stone;
  else if (peltwithblackstone) carryobject blackstone;
  else if (!peltwithnpc){
    i=bombscount-1;
    if (bombs[i].power==1) carryobject bomb;
    else if (bombs[i].power==2) carryobject superbomb;
    else if (bombs[i].power==3) carryobject joltbomb;
    removebomb i;
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function Direction(){
  if (this.distx<=this.disty){
    if (playery<y)dir=0;
    if (playery>y)dir=2;
  }else{
    if (playerx<x)dir=1;
    if (playerx>x)dir=3;
  }
}
function MoveCheck(){
  if (this.distx==0){
    this.addy=this.speed;
  }else if (this.disty==0){
    this.addx=this.speed;
  }else if (this.distx>this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.disty/this.distx;
    this.addx=this.speed;
    this.addy=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }else if (this.disty>this.distx){
    this.ratio=this.distx/this.disty;
    this.addy=this.speed;
    this.addx=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }
}
function Movement(){
  if (y<playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.addy)) y+=this.addy;
  if (y>playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y-this.addy)) y-=this.addy;
  if (x<playerx&&!onwall(x+3+this.addx,y+1.5)) x+=this.addx;
  if (x>playerx&&!onwall(x-this.addx,y+1.5)) x-=this.addx;
}
function BounceBack(){
  this.hit=1;
  while(this.hit==1){
    i+=.5;
    if (x>playerx&&!onwall(x+2.5,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<playerx&&!onwall(x-.5,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+2.5)) y+=.5;
    if (y<playery&&!onwall(x-1.5,y-.5)) y-=.5;
    if (i>=3.5){
      this.hit=0;
      i=0;
    }
    sleep .05;
  }
}
function SpinMove(){
  while(d<=8){
    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;
    sleep.1;
  }
}
function ItemDrop(){
  i = random(0,100);
  if (i<10) lay greenrupee;
  else if (i<15) lay bluerupee;
  else if (i<30) lay heart;
}
if (created){
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #n,Catcher (A);
  hearts=3;
  hurtdx=0;
  hurtdy=0;
}

  this.speed=.3;
  this.pow=2;
  this.attackdist=5;
  timeout=.05;
}

    SpriteAssign();

    Direction();
    MoveCheck();
    Movement();
    timeout=.05;
  }
}

 hurt this.pow;
}

function ItemIndex(){
  if (this.newdist<=this.curdist){
    this.curdist=this.newdist;
    this.tox=items[i].x;
    this.toy=items[i].y;
    this.itemindex=i;
  }
}
function TakeItem(){
  take2 this.itemindex;
  this.curdist=64;
}
function Steal(){
  hurt 0;
  sprite=39;
  i = random(1,100);
  if (i<10&&playerrupees>0){
    playerrupees--;
    lay2 greenrupee,random(playerx-5,playerx+5),random(playery-5,playery+5);
  } else if (i<15&&playerrupees>4){
    playerrupees-=5;
    lay2 bluerupee,random(playerx-5,playerx+5),random(playery-5,playery+5);
  } else if (i<25&&playerbombs>4){
    playerbombs-=5;
    lay2 bombs,random(playerx-5,playerx+5),random(playery-5,playery+5);
  } else if (i<45&&playerdarts>4){
    playerdarts-=5;
    lay2 darts,random(playerx-5,playerx+5),random(playery-5,playery+5);
  } else if (i<65&&playerdarts>4&&playerrupees>4){
    playerdarts-=5;
    lay2 darts,random(playerx-5,playerx+5),random(playery-5,playery+5);
    playerrupees-=5;
    lay2 bluerupee,random(playerx-5,playerx+5),random(playery-5,playery+5);
  } else if (i<85&&playerbombs>4&&playerrupees>4){
    playerbombs-=5;
    lay2 bombs,random(playerx-5,playerx+5),random(playery-5,playery+5);
    playerrupees-=5;
    lay2 bluerupee,random(playerx-5,playerx+5),random(playery-5,playery+5);
  } else if (i<=100&&playerbombs>4&&playerdarts>4){
    playerbombs-=5;
    lay2 bombs,random(playerx-5,playerx+5),random(playery-5,playery+5);
    playerdarts-=5;
    lay2 darts,random(playerx-5,playerx+5),random(playery-5,playery+5);
  }
}
function BounceBack(){
  this.hit=1;
  while(this.hit==1){
    i+=.5;
    if (x>playerx&&!onwall(x+2.5,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<playerx&&!onwall(x-.5,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+2.5)) y+=.5;
    if (y<playery&&!onwall(x-1.5,y-.5)) y-=.5;
    if (i>=5){
      this.hit=0;
      this.steal=1;
      i=0;
    }
    sleep .05;
  }
}
function SpinMove(){
  while(d<=8){
    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;
    sleep .1;
  }
}
function DropStolenStuff(){
  while (rupees>=100){
    lay goldrupee;
    rupees-=100;
  }
  while (rupees>=30){
    lay redrupee;
    rupees-=30;
  }
  while (rupees>=5){
    lay bluerupee;
    rupees-=5;
  }
  while (rupees>=1){
    lay greenrupee;
    rupees-=1;
  }
  while (bombs>=5){
    lay bombs;
    bombs-=5;
  }
  while (darts>=5){
    lay darts;
    darts-=5;
  }
}
if (created){
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #n,Zelda Thief (A);
  hearts=3;
  hurtdx=0;
  hurtdy=0;
}
if (playerenters||wasthrown){
  this.speed=.4;
  this.curdist=64;
  timeout=.05;
}
if (timeout&&isleader){
  if (hearts>0){
    sprite=(sprite%8)+1;
    if (this.steal!=1){
      GetDist();
      Direction();
      MoveCheck();
      Movement();
    }
    if (this.steal==1){
      for (i=0;i<itemscount;i++){
        GetDistItem();
        ItemIndex();
      }
      DirItem();
      MoveCheckItem();
      MovementItem();
    }
    timeout=.05;
  }
}
if (this.steal==1&&abs(this.tox-x)<=1&&abs(this.toy-y)<=1){
  TakeItem();
}
if (itemscount<1){
  this.steal=0;
}
if (hearts>0&&this.steal==0&&(playertouchsme||(abs((x+1.5)-(playerx+1.5))<=3 &&abs((playery+1.5)-(y+1.5))<=3))) {
  Steal();
  BounceBack();
  timeout=.05;
}
if ((washit||wasshot||exploded||waspelt)&&hearts>0){
  if (washit){
    hurtdx=x;
    hurtdy=y;
    hearts-=playerswordpower;
  }
  if (wasshot){
    hearts--;
  }
  if (exploded){
    hearts--;
  }
  if (waspelt){
    if (peltwithbush) hearts-=.5;
    if (peltwithsign || peltwithvase || peltwithstone) hearts-=1;
    if (peltwithblackstone) hearts -=1.5;
  }
  sprite=39;
  BounceBack();
  timeout=.05;
}
if (hurtdx!=0||hurtdy!=0){
  sprite=39;
  hurtdx=0;
  hurtdy=0;
}
if (timeout&&hearts<=0&&isleader){
  SpinMove();
  DropStolenStuff();
  sprite=40;
}
#+#// NPC Created By Ace2896
// Check out the new "Baddy Scripters' Guide"
// http://www.users.uswest.net/~ace2896/baddyscriptin.html

timereverywhere;
function GetDist(){
  this.distx=abs(playerx-x);
  this.disty=abs(playery-y);
}
function Direction(){
  if (this.distx<=this.disty){
    if (playery<y)dir=0;
    if (playery>y)dir=2;
  }else{
    if (playerx<x)dir=1;
    if (playerx>x)dir=3;
  }
}
function MoveCheck(){
  if (this.distx==0){
    this.addy=this.speed;
  }else if (this.disty==0){
    this.addx=this.speed;
  }else if (this.distx>this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.disty/this.distx;
    this.addx=this.speed;
    this.addy=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }else if (this.disty>this.distx){
    this.ratio=this.distx/this.disty;
    this.addy=this.speed;
    this.addx=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }
}
function Movement(){
  if (y<playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.addy)) y+=this.addy;
  if (y>playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y-this.addy)) y-=this.addy;
  if (x<playerx&&!onwall(x+3+this.addx,y+1.5)) x+=this.addx;
  if (x>playerx&&!onwall(x-this.addx,y+1.5)) x-=this.addx;
}
function Steal(){
  hurt 0;
  sprite=39;
  i = random(1,100);
  if (i<10&&playerrupees>0){
    playerrupees--;
    rupees++;
  } else if (i<15&&playerrupees>4){
    playerrupees-=5;
    rupees+=5;
  } else if (i<25&&playerbombs>4){
    playerbombs-=5;
    bombs+=5;
  } else if (i<45&&playerdarts>4){
    playerdarts-=5;
    darts+=5;
  } else if (i<65&&playerdarts>4&&playerrupees>4){
    playerdarts-=5;
    darts+=5;
    playerrupees-=5;
    rupees+=5;
  } else if (i<85&&playerbombs>4&&playerrupees>4){
    playerbombs-=5;
    bombs+=5;
    playerrupees-=5;
    rupees+=5;
  } else if (i<=100&&playerbombs>4&&playerdarts>4){
    playerbombs-=5;
    bombs+=5;
    playerdarts-=5;
    darts+=5;
  }
}
function BounceBack(){
  this.hit=1;
  while(this.hit==1){
    i+=.5;
    if (x>playerx&&!onwall(x+2.5,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<playerx&&!onwall(x-.5,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+2.5)) y+=.5;
    if (y<playery&&!onwall(x-1.5,y-.5)) y-=.5;
    if (i>=3.5){
      this.hit=0;
      i=0;
    }
    sleep .05;
  }
}
function SpinMove(){
  while(d<=8){
    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;
    sleep .1;
  }
}

  while (rupees>=100){

  timeout=.05;

  sprite=39;
  hurtdx=0;
  hurtdy=0;
}

    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;
    sleep .1;
  }
  while (rupees>=100){
    lay goldrupee;
    rupees-=100;

  while (rupees>=30){
    lay redrupee;
    rupees-=30;

    lay bluerupee;
    rupees-=5;

    lay greenrupee;
    rupees-=1;

// ===== 03_meh/Meh_baddypack/newbaddies__001__32_11.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: Meh/baddypack/newbaddies.nw

// header: NPC - 32 11
// image: -
// tile: 32,11
// recovered-from-binary: false

NPC - 32 11
// NPC made by Ace2896
function Initialize(){
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #n,GoodBow;
  shieldpower=0;
  setcharprop #2,blankbow.png;
  setcharprop #3,head19.png;
  hearts=10;
  this.speed=.4;
  swordpower=1;
  this.radius=1.5;
  this.keepdist=16;
  this.closedist=3;
  this.aout=0;
  timeout=.05;
}
function Convert(){
  this.curdist=64;
  for (i=0;i<compuscount;i++){
    if (!compus[i].mode==9&&!compus[i].mode==5){
      this.distx=abs(compus[i].x-x);
      this.disty=abs(compus[i].y-y);
      this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
      if (this.dist<this.curdist){
        this.curdist=this.dist;
        this.index=i;
      }
    }
  }
  this.testx=compus[this.index].x;
  this.testy=compus[this.index].y;
}
function SwordAttack(){
  if (sprite<13)sprite++;
  else {
    sprite=0;
    this.mode=0;
  }
}
function GetDist(){
  Convert();
  this.distx=abs(this.testx-x);
  this.disty=abs(this.testy-y);
  this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
}
function Direction(){
  GetDist();
  if (this.distx<=this.disty){
    if (this.testy<y)dir=0;
    if (this.testy>y)dir=2;
  }else{
    if (this.testx<x)dir=1;
    if (this.testx>x)dir=3;
  }
}
function BounceBack(){
  Convert();
  this.hit=0;
  while(this.hit<5){
    sprite=39;
    this.hit+=.5;
    if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x+3.5,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x-.5,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3.5)) y+=.5;
    if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+.5)) y-=.5;
    sleep .05;
  }
  sprite=0;
  timeout=.05;
}
function SpinMove(){
  sprite=0;
  while(d<=8){
    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;
    sleep .1;
  }
  sprite=40;
  for (i=0;i<this.aout+4;i++)deletestring trackaxyt,i;
}
function ShootBow(){
  if (this.shoot<10)this.shoot++;
  else {
    this.shoot=0;
    this.mode=0;
  }
  if (this.shoot==5){
    shootarrow dir;
    insertstring arrowtracking,this.aout,#v(arrowscount-1);
    this.aout++;
    sprite=0;
  }
}
function ArrowTrack(){
  for (i=0;i<this.aout;i++){
    this.adex=strtofloat(#I(arrowtracking,i));
    this.testx=arrows[this.adex].x;
    this.testy=arrows[this.adex].y;
    t=testcompu(this.testx,this.testy);
    if (t>=0){
      hitcompu t,swordpower,this.testx,this.testy;
      removearrow this.adex;
      deletestring arrowtracking,i;
      this.aout--;
    }
    if (this.testx>=64||this.testy>=64||this.testx<=0||this.testy<=0){
      deletestring arrowtracking,i;
      this.aout--;
    }
  }
}
function Aim(){
  sprite=(sprite%8)+1;
  GetDist();
  if (this.distx<this.disty){
    if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x+3+this.speed,y+1.5)){
      x+=this.speed;
      dir=3;
    }
    if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x-this.speed,y+1.5)){
      x-=this.speed;
      dir=1;
    }
  }else{
    if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.speed)){
      y+=this.speed;
      dir=2;
    }
    if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y-this.speed)){
      y-=this.speed;
      dir=0;
    }
  }
  if (this.dist<=this.keepdist){
    if (this.distx<this.disty){
      if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+1-(this.speed/2)))y-=(this.speed/2);
      if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+(this.speed/2)))y+=(this.speed/2);
    }
    if (this.disty<this.distx){
      if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x-(this.speed/2),y+1.5))x-=(this.speed/2);
      if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x+3+(this.speed/2),y+1.5))x+=(this.speed/2);
    }
  }
  if((x-this.testx<1&&this.testx-x<1)||(y-this.testy<1&&this.testy-y<1)){
    this.mode=1;
    Direction();
    setcharani shoot.gani,wbow1.png;
  }
  if (this.dist<=this.closedist){
    this.mode=2;
    sprite=9;
  }
}
if (playerenters){
  Initialize();
}
if (timeout&&(compuscount>0||this.aout>0)){
  if (this.mode==0)Aim();
  else if (this.mode==1) ShootBow();
  else if (this.mode==2) SwordAttack();
  if (hearts>0) timeout=.05;
  else SpinMove();
  if (this.aout>0) ArrowTrack();
}else{
  this.mode=0;
  sprite=0;
}
if ((washit||waspelt||exploded||(wasshot&&shotbyplayer))&&hearts>0){
  hearts-=playerswordpower;
  this.shoot=0;
  this.mode=0;
  BounceBack();
}

function Initialize(){

  this.speed=.4;
  swordpower=3;
  this.radius=1.5;
  this.attackdist=3;
  timeout=.05;
}
function Convert(){
  this.testx=playerx;
  this.testy=playery;
}
function GetDist(){
  Convert();
  this.distx=abs(this.testx-x);
  this.disty=abs(this.testy-y);
  this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
}
function Direction(){
  GetDist();
  if (this.distx<=this.disty){
    if (this.testy<y)dir=0;
    if (this.testy>y)dir=2;
  }else{
    if (this.testx<x)dir=1;
    if (this.testx>x)dir=3;
  }
}
function MoveCheck(){
  if (this.distx<=.5)this.addy=this.speed;
  else if (this.disty<=.5)this.addx=this.speed;
  else if (this.distx>this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.disty/this.distx;
    this.addx=this.speed;
    this.addy=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }else if (this.disty>this.distx){
    this.ratio=this.distx/this.disty;
    this.addy=this.speed;
    this.addx=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }
}
function Movement(){
  Direction();
  MoveCheck();
  sprite=(sprite%8)+1;
  if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.addy)) y+=this.addy;
  if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+1-this.addy)) y-=this.addy;
  if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x+3+this.addx,y+1.5)) x+=this.addx;
  if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x-this.addx,y+1.5)) x-=this.addx;
}
function BounceBack(){
  Convert();
  this.hit=0;
  while(this.hit<5){
    sprite=39;
    this.hit+=.5;
    if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x+3.5,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x-.5,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3.5)) y+=.5;
    if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+.5)) y-=.5;
    sleep .05;
  }
  sprite=0;
  timeout=.05;
}
function SpinMove(){
  sprite=0;
  while(d<=8){
    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;
    sleep .1;
  }
  sprite=40;
}
function AttackCheck(){
  GetDist();
  if (this.dist<=this.attackdist){
    this.attack=1;
    sprite=9;
  }
}
function HitCheck(){
  t=testcompu(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (t>=0)hitcompu t,swordpower,this.testx,this.testy;
  t=testplayer(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (t>=0)hitplayer t,swordpower,this.testx,this.testy;
}
function RadialHitDetection(){
  AttackCheck();
  for (this.angle=0;this.count<20;this.angle+=.314){
    this.testx=x+1+cos(this.angle)*this.radius;
    this.testy=y+1.3+sin(this.angle)*this.radius;
    this.count++;
    HitCheck();
  }
  this.count=0;
}
function SwordAttack(){
  if (sprite<13)sprite++;
  else {
    sprite=0;
    this.attack=0;
  }
}
if (playerenters){
  Initialize();
}
if (timeout&&compuscount>0){
  if (this.attack==0){
    Movement();
    RadialHitDetection();
  }else if (this.attack==1)SwordAttack();

  this.attack=0;
  hearts-=playerswordpower;
  this.attack=0;
  BounceBack();
}

    }
    if (this.distx==0){
      this.addy=this.speed;
    }else if (this.disty==0){
      this.addx=this.speed;
    }else if (this.distx>this.disty){
      this.ratio=this.disty/this.distx;
      this.addx=this.speed;
      this.addy=this.speed*this.ratio;
    }else if (this.disty>this.distx){
      this.ratio=this.distx/this.disty;
      this.addy=this.speed;
      this.addx=this.speed*this.ratio;
    }
    if (y<playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.addy)) y+=this.addy;
    if (y>playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y-this.addy)) y-=this.addy;
    if (x<playerx&&!onwall(x+3+this.addx,y+1.5)) x+=this.addx;
    if (x>playerx&&!onwall(x-this.addx,y+1.5)) x-=this.addx;
    this.dist=((this.distx)^2+(this.disty)^2)^.5;
    if (this.dist<=15&&this.flycounter==0){
      this.flyaddx=0;
      this.flyaddy=0;
      if (dir==0 || dir==2) sprite = 13;
      else sprite = 6;
      if (dir==0){
        showimg 1,wboom4.png,x-0.7,y+1.4;
        this.flyx=x-.7;
        this.flyy=y+1.4;
      }
      if (dir==1){
        showimg 1,wboom3.png,x+1.9,y+1.5;
        this.flyx=x+1.9;
        this.flyy=y+1.5;
      }
      if (dir==2){
        showimg 1,wboom2.png,x+2.3,y+0.7;
        this.flyx=x+2.3;
        this.flyy=y+.7;
      }
      if (dir==3){
        showimg 1,wboom2.png,x-0.2,y+1.5;
        this.flyx=x-.2;
        this.flyy=y+1.5;
      }
      this.throw=1;
    }
  }
  if (this.hit==1){
    i+=.5;
    if (x>playerx&&!onwall(x+3+i,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<playerx&&!onwall(x-i,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+i)) y+=.5;
    if (y<playery&&!onwall(x-1.5,y-i)) y-=.5;
    if (i>=3.5){
      this.hit=0;
      i=0;
    }
    timeout=.05;
  }
  if (this.flycounter>=1&&this.flycounter<this.boomdist){
    for (i=0;i<playerscount;i++){
      if (abs((players[i].x+1.5)-this.flyx)<=1.5&&
          abs((players[i].y+1.5)-this.flyy)<=1.5){
        hitplayer i,this.boompow,this.flyx,this.fly;
      }
    }
    showimg 1,wboom.png,this.flyx,this.flyy;
    this.flyx+=this.flyaddx;
    this.flyy+=this.flyaddy;
    this.flycounter++;
  }
  if (this.flycounter>=this.boomdist){
    for (i=0;i<playerscount;i++){
      if (abs((players[i].x+1.5)-this.flyx)<=1.5&&
          abs((players[i].y+1.5)-this.flyy)<=1.5){
        hitplayer i,this.boompow,this.flyx,this.fly;
      }
    }
    this.bdistx=abs(this.flyx-x);
    this.bdisty=abs(this.flyy-y);
    if (this.bdistx==0){
      if (y<this.flyy){
        this.flyaddy=-1.25;
      }else{
        this.flyaddy=1.25;
      }
      this.flyaddx=0;
    }else if (this.bdisty==0){
      if (x<this.flyx){
        this.flyaddx=-1.25;
      }else{
        this.flyaddx=1.25;
      }
      this.flyaddy=0;
    }else if (this.bdistx>this.bdisty){
      this.bratio=this.bdisty/this.bdistx;
      if (this.flyx<x){
        this.flyaddx=1.25;
      }else{
        this.flyaddx=-1.25;
      }
      if (this.flyy<y){
        this.flyaddy=1.25*this.bratio;
      }else{
        this.flyaddy=-1.25*this.bratio;
      }
    }else if (this.bdistx<this.bdisty){
      this.bratio=this.bdistx/this.bdisty;
      if (this.flyy<y){
        this.flyaddy=1.25;
      }else{
        this.flyaddy=-1.25;
      }
      if (this.flyx<x){
        this.flyaddx=1.25*this.bratio;
      }else{
        this.flyaddx=-1.25*this.bratio;
      }
    }
    showimg 1,wboom.png,this.flyx,this.flyy;
    this.flyx+=this.flyaddx;
    this.flyy+=this.flyaddy;
    if (this.bdistx<=1&&this.bdisty<=1){
      hideimg 1;
      this.flycounter=0;
    }
  }
  if (hearts>0&&this.hit!=1){
    timeout=.05;
  }
}
if (timeout&&this.throw==1&&isleader&&hearts>0){
  this.pbdistx=abs(playerx-x);
  this.pbdisty=abs(playery-y);
  if (this.pbdistx==0){
    if (this.flyy>playery){
      this.flyaddy=-1.25;
    }else{
      this.flyaddy=1.25;
    }
  }else if (this.pbdisty==0){
    if (this.flyx>playerx){
      this.flyaddx=-1.25;
    }else{
      this.flyaddx=1.25;
    }
  }else if (this.pbdistx>this.pbdisty){
    this.pbratio=this.pbdisty/this.pbdistx;
    if (this.flyx>playerx){
      this.flyaddx=-1;
    }else{
      this.flyaddx=1;
    }
    if (this.flyy>playery){
      this.flyaddy=-1*this.pbratio;
    }else{
      this.flyaddy=1*this.pbratio;
    }
  }else if (this.pbdistx<this.pbdisty){
    this.pbratio=this.pbdistx/this.pbdisty;
    if (this.flyy<playery){
      this.flyaddy=1;
    }else{
      this.flyaddy=-1;
    }
    if (this.flyx<playerx){
      this.flyaddx=1*this.pbratio;
    }else{
      this.flyaddx=-1*this.pbratio;
    }
  }
  sprite=11;
  this.throw=0;
  this.flycounter=1;
  timeout=.05;
}

  hurt this.pow;
}

 hurt this.pow;
}

  if (washit){
    hurtdx=x;
    hurtdy=y;
    hearts-=playerswordpower;
  }
  if (wasshot){
    hearts--;
  }
  if (exploded){
    hearts--;
  }
  if (waspelt){
    if (peltwithbush) hearts-=.5;
    if (peltwithsign || peltwithvase || peltwithstone) hearts-=1;
    if (peltwithblackstone) hearts -=1.5;
  }
  sprite=39;
  this.hit=1;
  timeout=.05;
}

  sprite=39;
  hurtdx=0;
  hurtdy=0;

    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;

      this.flyaddy=-1*this.pbratio;
    }else{
      this.flyaddy=1*this.pbratio;

    this.pbratio=this.pbdistx/this.pbdisty;
    if (this.flyy<playery){
      this.flyaddy=1;
    }else{
      this.flyaddy=-1;
    }

      this.flyaddx=1*this.pbratio;

      this.flyaddx=-1*this.pbratio;

  this.flycounter=1;

      sprite++;

      sprite=1;
    }
    this.distx=abs(playerx-x);
    this.disty=abs(playery-y);
    if (this.distx<=this.disty){
      if (playery<y)dir=0;
      if (playery>y)dir=2;
    }else{
      if (playerx<x)dir=1;
      if (playerx>x)dir=3;
    }
    this.dist=((this.distx^2)+(this.disty^2))^.5;

      this.step=0;

      this.flyy = y+1.25;

      if (dir==1) this.flyx+=0.5;

    if (this.distx==0){
      this.addy=this.speed;
    }else if (this.disty==0){
      this.addx=this.speed;
    }else if (this.distx>this.disty){
      this.ratio=this.disty/this.distx;
      this.addx=this.speed;
      this.addy=this.speed*this.ratio;
    }else if (this.disty>this.distx){
      this.ratio=this.distx/this.disty;
      this.addy=this.speed;
      this.addx=this.speed*this.ratio;
    }
    if (y<playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.addy)) y+=this.addy;
    if (y>playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y-this.addy)) y-=this.addy;
    if (x<playerx&&!onwall(x+3+this.addx,y+1.5)) x+=this.addx;
    if (x>playerx&&!onwall(x-this.addx,y+1.5)) x-=this.addx;
    timeout=.05;
  }
  if (this.hit==1){
    i+=.5;
    if (x>playerx&&!onwall(x+3+i,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<playerx&&!onwall(x-i,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+i)) y+=.5;

    if (i>=3.5){
      this.hit=0;
      i=0;
    }
    timeout=.05;
  }

    this.attack=0;

7(cutteri.png#// NPC made by Ace2896
// This is one of the custom bow NPCs
// You can use these to make your own bow-like weapons.
// If you scroll down the script until you see the function "SetVars",
// you'll notice the following variables:
// "this.pow" is the number of half hearts taken off when it hits something
// With "this.wallstop" if it is equal to 1, the arrow will stop when it hits a wall
// "this.cost" is the number of darts it costs to use the weapon
//
// If you would like to make your own graphics for it, follow these simple steps:
// make the images for it by editing the provided graphics;
// scroll down to the function "FlipArrow" and look for the part that says "showimg..."
// notice the name of the file it shows;
// in a text editor, search for that file name, and replace it with your own...
// since there are multiple spots that use that same file, I recommend using search.
// Near the very bottom of the script is the "if (weaponfired...)" stuff...
// where it says "setbow" change the name of the file there to display a bow you made.
//
// I believe thats about it.  Of course you could try and figure out all of the script,
// and throw in your own functions and flags to make something even more unique.
//
function ConvertA(){
  this.testx=this.arrowx[a]+offset[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
  this.testy=this.arrowy[a]+offset[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1];
}
function FlipArrow(){
  this.arrowp[a]+=.05;
  if (this.ix<6)this.ix+=2;
  else this.ix=0;
  if (this.iy<7)this.iy+=2;
  else this.iy=1;
  this.arrowx[a]-=dirgo[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
  this.arrowy[a]-=dirgo[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1]*;
  showimg a,cutters.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  changeimgpart a,imgvis[this.ix],imgvis[this.iy],imgprt[this.ix],imgprt[this.iy];
  if (this.arrowp[a]==0)RemoveArrow();
}
function HitCheck(){
  c=testcompu(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (c>=0){
    hitcompu c,this.pow,this.testx,this.testy;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  p=testplayer(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (p>0){
    if (players[p].dir=(this.arrowdir[a]+2)%4){
      if (players[p].shieldpower>1)this.arrowdir[a]=(this.arrowdir[a]+2)%4;
      else if (players[p].shieldpower==1)this.arrowp[a]=-.15;
      play arrowon.wav;
    }else {
      hitplayer p,this.pow,this.testx,this.testy;
      RemoveArrow();
    }
  }
  b=testbomb(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (b>=0){
    explodebomb b;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  n=testnpc(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (n>=0&&npcs[n].hurtdx==0&&npcs[n].hurtdy==0){
    callnpc n,washit;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  e=testexplo(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (e>=0)this.onfire[a]=1;
}
function LayItem(){
  i=random(0,100);
  if (i<5) lay2 heart,putx,puty;
  else if (i<10) lay2 bombs,putx,puty;
  else if (i<20) lay2 bluerupee,putx,puty;
  else if (i<35) lay2 greenrupee,putx,puty;
}
function MoveArrow(){
  this.ix=this.arrowdir[a]*2;
  this.iy=(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1;
  this.arrowx[a]+=dirgo[this.ix];
  this.arrowy[a]+=dirgo[this.iy];
  if (this.onfire[a]!=1)showimg a,cutters.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  else showimg a,fireblasts.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  changeimgpart a,imgvis[this.ix],imgvis[this.iy],imgprt[this.ix],imgprt[this.iy];
  ConvertA();
  if (onwall(this.testx,this.testy)){
    n=testnpc(this.testx,this.testy);
    if (n>=0&&npcs[n].hurtdx==0&&npcs[n].hurtdy==0){
      RemoveArrow();
      callnpc n,washit;
    }else TileCheck();
  }else HitCheck();
  if (this.testx<0||this.testy<0||this.testx>63||this.testy>63)RemoveArrow();
}
function RemoveArrow(){
  if (this.onfire[a]==1){
    this.arrowx[a]-=dirgo[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
    this.arrowy[a]-=dirgo[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1];
    putexplosion2 1,1,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  }
  hideimg a;
  for (b=a; b<=this.out; b++) {
    this.arrowx[b]=this.arrowx[b+1];
    this.arrowy[b]=this.arrowy[b+1];
    this.arrowdir[b]=this.arrowdir[b+1];
    this.arrowp[b]=this.arrowp[b+1];
    this.onfire[b]=this.onfire[b+1];
  }
  this.arrowx[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowy[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowdir[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowp[this.out]=-1;
  this.onfire[this.out]=-1;
  a--;
  this.out--;
  hideimg this.out;
}
function SetVars(){
  this.pow=2;
  this.wallstop=1;
  this.cost=1;
  playerdarts-=this.cost;
  this.ix=playerdir*2;
  this.iy=(playerdir*2)+1;
  this.arrowx[this.out]=playerx+this.imgpos[this.ix];
  this.arrowy[this.out]=playery+this.imgpos[this.iy];
  this.arrowdir[this.out]=playerdir;
  this.arrowp[this.out]=.25;
  showimg this.out,cutters.png,this.arrowx[this.out],this.arrowy[this.out];
  changeimgpart this.out,imgvis[this.ix],imgvis[this.iy],imgprt[this.ix],imgprt[this.iy];
  if (playerdir!=2)changeimgvis this.out,0;
  else changeimgvis this.out,2;
}
function TileCheck(){
  putx=int(this.testx);
  puty=int(this.testy);
  b = board[putx+64*puty];
  bx = b % 16;
  by = int(b / 16);
  if ((bx==2||bx==3)&&(by==0||by==1)){
    if(bx==3)putx--;
    if(by==1)puty--;
    putleaps 0,putx,puty;
    board[putx+64*puty] = 5+42*16;
    board[putx+1+64*puty] = 6+42*16;
    board[putx+64*(puty+1)] = 5+43*16;
    board[putx+1+64*(puty+1)] = 6+43*16;
    updateboard putx,puty,2,2;
    LayItem();
  }else if (this.onfire[a]==1)RemoveArrow();
  else if (this.wallstop==1) this.arrowp[a]=-.15;
}
if (this.int!=1){
  this.max=15;
  dirgo = {0,-1,-1,0,0,1,1,0};
  imgvis = {16,32,0,16,0,32,0,0};
  this.imgpos = {.5,0,-1,1.375,1,1.75,1.75,1.375};
  imgprt = {16,32,32,16,16,32,32,16};
  offset = {.5,1,1,.5,.5,1,1,.5};
  setarray this.arrowx,this.max;
  setarray this.arrowy,this.max;
  setarray this.arrowdir,this.max;
  setarray this.arrowp,this.max;
  setarray this.onfire,this.max;
  this.int=1;
}
if (playertouchsme){
  toweapons Cutter;
  hidelocal;
}
if (weaponfired&&playerdarts>=this.cost&&this.out<this.max&&
   (!((playerdir==0&&playery<=0)||
      (playerdir==1&&playerx<=0)))){
  setbow cutterbow.png;
  playersprite=33;
  SetVars();
  freezeplayer .3;
  this.out++;
  play arrow.wav;
  timeout=.05;
}
if (timeout&&this.out>0){
  for (a=0;a<this.out;a++){
    if (this.arrowp[a]>0)this.arrowp[a]-=.05;
    else if (this.arrowp[a]<0)FlipArrow();
    else MoveArrow();
  }
  timeout=.05;
}

  c=testcompu(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (c>=0){
    hitcompu c,this.pow,this.testx,this.testy;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  p=testplayer(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (p>0){
    if (players[p].dir=(this.arrowdir[a]+2)%4){
      if (players[p].shieldpower>1)this.arrowdir[a]=(this.arrowdir[a]+2)%4;
      else if (players[p].shieldpower==1)this.arrowp[a]=-.15;
      play arrowon.wav;
    }else {
      hitplayer p,this.pow,this.testx,this.testy;
      RemoveArrow();
    }
  }
  b=testbomb(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (b>=0){
    explodebomb b;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  n=testnpc(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (n>=0&&npcs[n].hurtdx==0&&npcs[n].hurtdy==0){
    callnpc n,washit;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  e=testexplo(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (e>=0)this.onfire[a]=1;
}
function MoveArrow(){
  this.ix=this.arrowdir[a]*2;
  this.iy=(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1;
  this.arrowx[a]+=dirgo[this.ix];
  this.arrowy[a]+=dirgo[this.iy];
  if (this.onfire[a]!=1)showimg a,medarrows.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  else showimg a,fireblasts.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  changeimgpart a,imgvis[this.ix],imgvis[this.iy],imgprt[this.ix],imgprt[this.iy];
  if (this.arrowx[a]<0||this.arrowy[a]<0||this.arrowx[a]>63||this.arrowy[a]>63)RemoveArrow();
  ConvertA();
  if (onwall(this.testx,this.testy)){
    n=testnpc(this.testx,this.testy);
    if (n>=0&&npcs[n].hurtdx==0&&npcs[n].hurtdy==0){
      RemoveArrow();
      callnpc n,washit;
    }else if (this.onfire[a]==1)RemoveArrow();
    else if (this.wallstop==1)this.arrowp[a]=-.15;
  }else HitCheck();
}
function RemoveArrow(){
  if (this.onfire[a]==1){
    this.arrowx[a]-=dirgo[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
    this.arrowy[a]-=dirgo[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1];
    putexplosion2 1,1,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  }
  hideimg a;
  for (b=a; b<=this.out; b++) {
    this.arrowx[b]=this.arrowx[b+1];
    this.arrowy[b]=this.arrowy[b+1];
    this.arrowdir[b]=this.arrowdir[b+1];
    this.arrowp[b]=this.arrowp[b+1];
    this.onfire[b]=this.onfire[b+1];
  }
  this.arrowx[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowy[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowdir[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowp[this.out]=-1;
  this.onfire[this.out]=-1;
  a--;
  this.out--;
  hideimg this.out;
}
function SetVars(){
  this.pow=1;
  this.wallstop=0;
  this.cost=1;
  playerdarts-=this.cost;
  this.ix=playerdir*2;
  this.iy=(playerdir*2)+1;
  this.arrowx[this.out]=playerx+this.imgpos[this.ix];
  this.arrowy[this.out]=playery+this.imgpos[this.iy];
  this.arrowdir[this.out]=playerdir;
  this.arrowp[this.out]=.25;
  showimg this.out,medarrows.png,this.arrowx[this.out],this.arrowy[this.out];
  changeimgpart this.out,imgvis[this.ix],imgvis[this.iy],imgprt[this.ix],imgprt[this.iy];
  if (playerdir!=2)changeimgvis this.out,0;
  else changeimgvis this.out,2;
}
if (this.int!=1){
  this.max=15;
  dirgo = {0,-1,-1,0,0,1,1,0};
  imgvis = {16,32,0,16,0,32,0,0};
  this.imgpos = {.5,0,-1,1.375,1.3125,1.5,1.75,1.375};
  imgprt = {16,32,32,16,16,32,32,16};
  offset = {.5,1,1,.5,.5,1,1,.5};
  setarray this.arrowx,this.max;
  setarray this.arrowy,this.max;
  setarray this.arrowdir,this.max;
  setarray this.arrowp,this.max;
  setarray this.onfire,this.max;
  this.int=1;
}
if (playertouchsme){
  toweapons MedBow;
  hidelocal;
}
if (weaponfired&&playerdarts>=this.cost&&this.out<this.max&&
   (!((playerdir==0&&playery<=0)||
      (playerdir==1&&playerx<=0)))){
  setbow medbow.png;
  playersprite=33;
  SetVars();
  freezeplayer .3;
  this.out++;
  play arrow.wav;
  timeout=.05;
}
if (timeout&&this.out>0){
  for (a=0;a<this.out;a++){
    if (this.arrowp[a]>0)this.arrowp[a]-=.05;
    else if (this.arrowp[a]<0)FlipArrow();
    else MoveArrow();
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
/(wbowi2.png#// NPC made by Ace2896
// This is one of the custom bow NPCs
// You can use these to make your own bow-like weapons.
// If you scroll down the script until you see the function "SetVars",
// you'll notice the following variables:
// "this.pow" is the number of half hearts taken off when it hits something
// With "this.wallstop" if it is equal to 1, the arrow will stop when it hits a wall
// "this.cost" is the number of darts it costs to use the weapon
//
// If you would like to make your own graphics for it, follow these simple steps:
// make the images for it by editing the provided graphics;
// scroll down to the function "FlipArrow" and look for the part that says "showimg..."
// notice the name of the file it shows;

// since there are multiple spots that use that same file, I recommend using search.
// Near the very bottom of the script is the "if (weaponfired...)" stuff...

//
// I believe thats about it.  Of course you could try and figure out all of the script,
// and throw in your own functions and flags to make something even more unique.
//
function ConvertA(){
  this.testx=this.arrowx[a]+offset[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
  this.testy=this.arrowy[a]+offset[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1];
}
function FlipArrow(){
  this.arrowp[a]+=.05;
  if (this.ix<6)this.ix+=2;
  else this.ix=0;
  if (this.iy<7)this.iy+=2;
  else this.iy=1;
  this.arrowx[a]-=dirgo[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
  this.arrowy[a]-=dirgo[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1]*;
  showimg a,fireballs.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  changeimgpart a,imgvis[this.ix],imgvis[this.iy],imgprt[this.ix],imgprt[this.iy];
  if (this.arrowp[a]==0)RemoveArrow();
}
function HitCheck(){
  ConvertA();
  c=testcompu(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (c>=0){
    hitcompu c,this.pow,this.testx,this.testy;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  p=testplayer(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (p>0){
    if (players[p].dir=(this.arrowdir[a]+2)%4){
      if (players[p].shieldpower>1)this.arrowdir[a]=(this.arrowdir[a]+2)%4;
      else if (players[p].shieldpower==1)this.arrowp[a]=-.15;
      play arrowon.wav;
    }else {
      hitplayer p,this.pow,this.testx,this.testy;
      RemoveArrow();
    }
  }
  b=testbomb(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (b>=0){
    explodebomb b;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  n=testnpc(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (n>=0&&npcs[n].hurtdx==0&&npcs[n].hurtdy==0){
    callnpc n,washit;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  e=testexplo(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (e>=0)this.onfire[a]=1;
}
function MoveArrow(){
  this.ix=this.arrowdir[a]*2;
  this.iy=(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1;
  this.arrowx[a]+=dirgo[this.ix];
  this.arrowy[a]+=dirgo[this.iy];
  if (this.onfire[a]!=1)showimg a,fireballs.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  else showimg a,fireblasts.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];

  ConvertA();
  if (onwall(this.testx,this.testy)){

      RemoveArrow();
      callnpc n,washit;
    }else if (this.onfire[a]==1)RemoveArrow();
    else if (this.wallstop==1)this.arrowp[a]=-.15;
  }else HitCheck();
}
function RemoveArrow(){
  if (this.onfire[a]==1){
    this.arrowx[a]-=dirgo[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
    this.arrowy[a]-=dirgo[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1];
    putexplosion2 1,1,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];

  this.arrowp[this.out]=-1;
  this.onfire[this.out]=-1;
  a--;
  this.out--;
  hideimg this.out;
}

function HitCheck(){
  ConvertA();
  i=testitem(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (i>=0){
    if (items[i].type==0)playerrupees+=1;
    if (items[i].type==1)playerrupees+=5;
    if (items[i].type==2)playerrupees+=30;
    if (items[i].type==3)playerbombs+=5;
    if (items[i].type==4)playerdarts+=5;
    if (items[i].type==5)playerhearts+=1;
    if (items[i].type==19)playerrupees+=100;
    take2 i;
    play extra.wav;
  }
  e=testexplo(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (e>=0)this.onfire[a]=1;
  if (this.onfire[a]==1){
    c=testcompu(this.testx,this.testy);
    if (c>=0){
      hitcompu c,this.pow,this.testx,this.testy;
      RemoveArrow();

    if (p>0){
      if (players[p].dir=(this.arrowdir[a]+2)%4){
        if (players[p].shieldpower>1)this.arrowdir[a]=(this.arrowdir[a]+2)%4;
        else if (players[p].shieldpower==1)this.arrowp[a]=-.15;
        play arrowon.wav;
      }else {
        hitplayer p,this.pow,this.testx,this.testy;
        RemoveArrow();
      }

    if (b>=0){
      explodebomb b;
      RemoveArrow();
    }

      callnpc n,washit;
      RemoveArrow();
    }
  }

5*nuke2i.png#// NPC made by Ace2896
// This is one of the custom bow NPCs
// You can use these to make your own bow-like weapons.
// If you scroll down the script until you see the function "SetVars",
// you'll notice the following variables:
// "this.pow" is the number of half hearts taken off when it hits something
// With "this.wallstop" if it is equal to 1, the arrow will stop when it hits a wall
// "this.cost" is the number of darts it costs to use the weapon
//
// If you would like to make your own graphics for it, follow these simple steps:
// make the images for it by editing the provided graphics;
// scroll down to the function "FlipArrow" and look for the part that says "showimg..."
// notice the name of the file it shows;
// in a text editor, search for that file name, and replace it with your own...
// since there are multiple spots that use that same file, I recommend using search.
// Near the very bottom of the script is the "if (weaponfired...)" stuff...
// where it says "setbow" change the name of the file there to display a bow you made.
//
// I believe thats about it.  Of course you could try and figure out all of the script,
// and throw in your own functions and flags to make something even more unique.
//
function ConvertA(){
  this.testx=this.arrowx[a]+offset[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
  this.testy=this.arrowy[a]+offset[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1];
}
function HitCheck(){
  c=testcompu(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (c>=0){
    hitcompu c,this.pow,this.testx,this.testy;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  p=testplayer(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (p>0){
    hitplayer p,this.pow,this.testx,this.testy;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  b=testbomb(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (b>=0){
    explodebomb b;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  n=testnpc(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (n>=0&&npcs[n].hurtdx==0&&npcs[n].hurtdy==0){
    callnpc n,washit;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
}
function MoveArrow(){
  this.ix=this.arrowdir[a]*2;
  this.iy=(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1;
  this.arrowx[a]+=dirgo[this.ix];
  this.arrowy[a]+=dirgo[this.iy];
  showimg a,nukes2.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  changeimgpart a,imgvis[this.ix],imgvis[this.iy],imgprt[this.ix],imgprt[this.iy];
  ConvertA();
  if (onwall(this.testx,this.testy)){
    n=testnpc(this.testx,this.testy);
    if (n>=0&&npcs[n].hurtdx==0&&npcs[n].hurtdy==0){
      RemoveArrow();
      callnpc n,washit;
    }else if (this.wallstop==1)RemoveArrow();
  }else HitCheck();
}
function RemoveArrow(){
  this.arrowx[a]-=dirgo[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
  this.arrowy[a]-=dirgo[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1];
  putexplosion2 3,2,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  hideimg a;
  for (b=a; b<=this.out; b++) {
    this.arrowx[b]=this.arrowx[b+1];
    this.arrowy[b]=this.arrowy[b+1];
    this.arrowdir[b]=this.arrowdir[b+1];
    this.arrowp[b]=this.arrowp[b+1];
  }
  this.arrowx[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowy[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowdir[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowp[this.out]=-1;
  a--;
  this.out--;
  hideimg this.out;
}

  this.pow=2;
  this.wallstop=1;
  this.cost=2;

function ConvertA(){
  this.testx=this.arrowx[a]+offset[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
  this.testy=this.arrowy[a]+offset[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1];
}
function FlipArrow(){
  this.arrowp[a]+=.05;
  if (this.ix<6)this.ix+=2;
  else this.ix=0;
  if (this.iy<7)this.iy+=2;
  else this.iy=1;
  this.arrowx[a]-=dirgo[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
  this.arrowy[a]-=dirgo[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1]*;
  showimg a,arrows.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  changeimgpart a,imgvis[this.ix],imgvis[this.iy],imgprt[this.ix],imgprt[this.iy];
  if (this.arrowp[a]==0)RemoveArrow();
}
function HitCheck(){
  ConvertA();
  c=testcompu(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (c>=0){
    hitcompu c,this.pow,this.testx,this.testy;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  p=testplayer(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (p>0){
    if (players[p].dir=(this.arrowdir[a]+2)%4){
      if (players[p].shieldpower>1)this.arrowdir[a]=(this.arrowdir[a]+2)%4;
      else if (players[p].shieldpower==1)this.arrowp[a]=-.15;
      play arrowon.wav;
    }else {
      hitplayer p,this.pow,this.testx,this.testy;
      RemoveArrow();
    }
  }
  b=testbomb(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (b>=0){
    explodebomb b;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  n=testnpc(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (n>=0&&npcs[n].hurtdx==0&&npcs[n].hurtdy==0){
    callnpc n,washit;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  e=testexplo(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (e>=0)this.onfire[a]=1;
}
function MoveArrow(){
  this.ix=this.arrowdir[a]*2;
  this.iy=(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1;
  this.arrowx[a]+=dirgo[this.ix];
  this.arrowy[a]+=dirgo[this.iy];
  if (this.onfire[a]!=1)showimg a,arrows.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  else showimg a,fireblasts.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  changeimgpart a,imgvis[this.ix],imgvis[this.iy],imgprt[this.ix],imgprt[this.iy];
  if (this.arrowx[a]<0||this.arrowy[a]<0||this.arrowx[a]>63||this.arrowy[a]>63)RemoveArrow();
  ConvertA();
  if (onwall(this.testx,this.testy)){
    n=testnpc(this.testx,this.testy);
    if (n>=0&&npcs[n].hurtdx==0&&npcs[n].hurtdy==0){
      RemoveArrow();
      callnpc n,washit;
    }else if (this.onfire[a]==1)RemoveArrow();
    else if (this.wallstop==1)this.arrowp[a]=-.15;
  }else HitCheck();
}
function RemoveArrow(){
  if (this.onfire[a]==1){
    this.arrowx[a]-=dirgo[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
    this.arrowy[a]-=dirgo[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1];
    putexplosion2 1,1,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  }
  hideimg a;
  for (b=a; b<=this.out; b++) {
    this.arrowx[b]=this.arrowx[b+1];
    this.arrowy[b]=this.arrowy[b+1];
    this.arrowdir[b]=this.arrowdir[b+1];
    this.arrowp[b]=this.arrowp[b+1];
    this.onfire[b]=this.onfire[b+1];
  }
  this.arrowx[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowy[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowdir[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowp[this.out]=-1;
  this.onfire[this.out]=-1;
  a--;
  this.out--;
  hideimg this.out;
}

3,hooki.png#// NPC made by Ace2896
// This is the fourth time I've re-written this
// It will only grapple stakes, and you can go over cliffs and blackness
// Hopefully its example level will show you what it can do.
// Note you can not go up a cliff face.
// And you can not grapple something if there is no room for the player to be pulled to it.
//
// It can now cut bushes,  explode bombs, and grapple push/pull blocks
// Also, the grapple-able tiles are in an array, so new ones can be added easily.
//
// Finally, Any npcs with a "save[9]" var of 220 can be grappled.
// Does not work with showcharacter npcs.
//
himgvis = {0,0,0,16,16,0,16,16,32,0,32,16,48,0,48,16};
rimgvis = {64,0,64,16,64,0,64,16};
dirgo = {0,-1,-1,0,0,1,1,0};
owc = {.5,2.5, 2.5,.5, .5,-1.5, -1.5,.5};
hookset = {.375,.1875,-.75,1.375,1.1875,2.25,2.875,1.375};
tiles = {10,20,10,21,11,20,11,21,
          4,110,4,111,5,110,5,111,
          14,124,14,125,15,124,15,125}
function Contact(){
  this.real=1;
  putleaps 4,this.hx+.5,this.hy+.5;
}
function HitCheck(){
  c=testcompu(this.hx+.5,this.hy+.5);
  if (c>=0){
    hitcompu c,this.pow,this.hx+.5,this.hy+.5;
    Contact();
  }
  p=testplayer(this.hx+.5,this.hy+.5);
  if (p>0){
    hitplayer p,this.pow,this.hx+.5,this.hy+.5;
    Contact();
  }
  b=testbomb(this.hx+.5,this.hy+.5);
  if (b>=0){
    explodebomb b;
    Contact();
  }
  n=testnpc(this.hx+.5,this.hy+.5);
  if (n>=0&&npcs[n].hurtdx==0&&npcs[n].hurtdy==0){
    if(npcs[n].save[9]==220&&!onwall(this.hx+owc[playerdir*2],this.hy+owc[(playerdir*2)+1])){
      putleaps 4,this.hx+.5,this.hy+.5;
      this.pull=1;
      ori=1;
    }else {
      Contact();
      callnpc n,washit;
    }
  }
}
function LayItem(){
  i=random(0,100);
  if (i<5) lay2 heart,putx,puty;
  else if (i<10) lay2 bombs,putx,puty;
  else if (i<20) lay2 bluerupee,putx,puty;
  else if (i<35) lay2 greenrupee,putx,puty;
}
function LifeSave(){
  this.real=2;
  this.pull=0;
  this.skip=0;
  this.pause=0;
  for (i=0;i<21;i++)hideimg i;
}
function PullPlayer(){
  freezeplayer .05;
  hideimg ori;
  ori++;
  if (ori==ri){
    this.pull=0;
    this.real=2;
    if (playerdir==1||playerdir==3){
      playerx+=dirgo[playerdir*2];
      playery+=dirgo[(playerdir*2)+1];
    }
  }
  if (this.pull!=0){
    playerx+=dirgo[playerdir*2];
    playery+=dirgo[(playerdir*2)+1];
  }
}
function RealHook(){
  freezeplayer .05;
  hideimg ri;
  ri--;
  this.hx-=dirgo[this.hdir*2];
  this.hy-=dirgo[(this.hdir*2)+1];
  showimg 0,hook.png,this.hx,this.hy;
  changeimgpart 0,himgvis[ix],himgvis[iy],16,16;
  if (playerdir==0)changeimgvis 0,2;
  HitCheck();
}
function SetVars(){
  ix=playerdir*4;
  iy=(playerdir*4)+1;
  rix=playerdir*2;
  riy=(playerdir*2)+1;
  ri=1;
  this.hdir=playerdir;
  this.ph=playerhearts;
  this.pow=1;
  this.real=0;
  this.pull=0;
  this.skip=0;
  this.pause=0;
  setbow hookshot.png;
  this.hx=playerx+hookset[playerdir*2];
  this.hy=playery+hookset[(playerdir*2)+1];
}
function ShootHook(){
  freezeplayer .05;
  this.hx+=dirgo[this.hdir*2];
  this.hy+=dirgo[(this.hdir*2)+1];
  showimg 0,hook.png,this.hx,this.hy;
  changeimgpart 0,himgvis[ix],himgvis[iy],16,16;
  showimg ri,hook.png,this.hx-dirgo[playerdir*2],this.hy-dirgo[(playerdir*2)+1];
  changeimgpart ri,rimgvis[rix],rimgvis[riy],16,16;
  if (playerdir==0)changeimgvis 0,0;
  else changeimgvis 0,2;
  if (playerdir==2)changeimgvis ri,2;
  else changeimgvis ri,0;
  ri++;
  if (ri==20)this.real=1;
  HitCheck();
}
function TileCheck(){
  putx=int(this.hx+.5);
  puty=int(this.hy+.5);
  b = board[putx+64*puty];
  bx = b % 16;
  by = int(b / 16);
  this.g=1;
  for (tx=0;tx<22;tx+=2) for (ty=1;ty<23;ty+=2){
    if (bx=tiles[tx]&&by==tiles[ty]){
      this.g=0;
      putleaps 3,putx,puty;
      if (!onwall(this.hx+owc[playerdir*2],this.hy+owc[(playerdir*2)+1])){
        this.pull=1;
        ori=1;
      }else{
        putleaps 4,this.hx,this.hy;
        this.real=1;
      }
    }
  }
  if (this.g==1){
    this.g=0;
    if ((bx==2||bx==3)&&(by==0||by==1)){
      if(bx==3)putx--;
      if(by==1)puty--;
      putleaps 0,putx,puty;
      board[putx+64*puty] = 5+42*16;
      board[putx+1+64*puty] = 6+42*16;
      board[putx+64*(puty+1)] = 5+43*16;
      board[putx+1+64*(puty+1)] = 6+43*16;
      updateboard putx,puty,2,2;
      LayItem();
      this.real=1;
    }else if (bx==8&&by==39)this.pause=1;
    else if (this.skip!=1&&(playerdir==0&&((bx==14||bx==15)&&by==11))||
            (playerdir==1&&(bx==3&&(by==17||by==18)))||
            (playerdir==2&&((bx==9||bx==10)&&by==11))||
            (playerdir==3&&(bx==1&&(by==17||by==18)))){
      if (playerdir==2)this.pause=5;
      else this.pause=3;
      this.skip=1;
    }else if (this.skip==1&&(playerdir==0&&((bx==9||bx==10)&&by==15))||
             (playerdir==1&&(bx==4&&(by==13||by==14)))||
             (playerdir==2&&((bx==14||bx==15)&&by==10))||
             (playerdir==3&&(bx==2&&(by==13||by==14)))){
      if (playerdir==0)this.pause=5;
      else this.pause=3;
      this.skip=0;
    }else{
      putleaps 4,this.hx,this.hy;
      this.real=1;
    }
  }
}

6=#// NPC made by Ace2896
function Initialize(){
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #n,BadSword2;
  setcharprop #2,shield3.png;
  setcharprop #1,sword3.png;
  hearts=10;
  this.speed=.4;
  swordpower=5;
  this.attackdist=3;
  this.throwdist=7;
}
function BushLift(){
  sprite=23;
  this.check++;
  message You can't stop me!;
  this.mcount=0;
  if (this.check==6){
    putleaps 0,this.tempx,this.tempy;
    for (tx=0;tx<=1;tx++) for (ty=0;ty<=1;ty++)
      board[(this.tempx+tx)+64*(this.tempy+ty)]=(5+tx)+(42+ty)*16;
    updateboard this.tempx,this.tempy,2,2;
    this.tempx=-1;
    this.tempy=-1;
    this.check=-1;
    this.mode=3;
    carryobject bush;
    sprite=24;
  }
}
function BushCheck(){
  this.tempx+=2*vecx(dir);
  this.tempy+=2*vecy(dir);
  this.testx = tiles[int(this.tempx),int(this.tempy)] % 16;
  this.testy = int(tiles[int(this.tempx),int(this.tempy)] / 16);
  if ((this.testx==2||this.testx==3)&&(this.testy==0||this.testy==1)){
    if(this.testx==3)this.tempx--;
    if(this.testy==1)this.tempy--;
    throwcarry;
    this.mode=2;
    this.check=-1;
  }
}
function StuckCheck(){
  if (this.check==0){
    this.tempx=int(x+1.5);
    this.tempy=int(y+2);
  }
  if (this.check==5){
    if (abs(this.tempx-int(x+1.5))<=.1&&abs(this.tempy-int(y+2))<=.1) BushCheck();
    this.check=-1;
  }
  this.check++;
}
function Convert(){
  this.testx=playerx;
  this.testy=playery;
}
function GetDist(){
  Convert();
  this.distx=abs(this.testx-x);
  this.disty=abs(this.testy-y);
  this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
}
function MoveCheck(){
  GetDist();
  this.addx=(this.distx/this.dist)*this.speed;
  this.addy=(this.disty/this.dist)*this.speed;
  if (this.testx<x)this.addx*=-1;
  if (this.testy<y)this.addy*=-1;
}
function Sprites(){
  if (this.mode==0)sprite=(sprite%8)+1;
  else if (this.mode==3){
    if (sprite<32)sprite++;
    else sprite=25;
  }
}
function Movement(){
  MoveCheck();
  dir=getdir(this.testx-x,this.testy-y);
  Sprites();
  if (this.dist>this.attackdist){
    if (!onwall(x+1.5+this.addx,y+2+this.addy)){
      x+=this.addx;
      y+=this.addy;
    }else if (!onwall(x+1.5,y+2+this.addy)) y+=this.addy;
    else if (!onwall(x+1.5+this.addx,y+2)) x+=this.addx;
  }
  StuckCheck();
}
function BounceBack(){
  Convert();
  this.check=0;
  while(this.check<5){
    sprite=39;
    this.check+=.5;
    if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x+3.5,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x-.5,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3.5)) y+=.5;
    if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+.5)) y-=.5;
    sleep .05;
  }
  sprite=0;
  this.check=-1;
  timeout=.05;
}
function SpinMove(){
  message ARRRGH!;
  sprite=0;
  while(d<=8){
    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;
    sleep .1;
  }
  sprite=40;
}
function AttackCheck(){
  GetDist();
  if (this.dist<=this.throwdist&&this.mode==3){
    throwcarry;
    sprite=0;
    this.mode=0;
    message Eat bush!;
    this.mcount=0;
  }else if (this.dist<=this.attackdist&&this.mode==0){
    this.mode=1;
    sprite=9;
    message Eat steel!;
    this.mcount=20;
  }
}
function SwordAttack(){
  if (sprite<13)sprite++;
  else {
    sprite=0;
    this.mode=0;
  }
}
function Speak(){
  if (this.mcount<40)this.mcount++;
  else if (this.mcount>=40){
    this.mcount=0;
    this.msg=int(random(0,4));
    if (this.msg==0)message DIE!;
    if (this.msg==1)message I'll get joo!;
    if (this.msg==2)message You fight like my grandma!;
    if (this.msg==3)message Quit running!;
  }
}
if (playerenters){
  Initialize();
}
if (timeout){
  if (this.mode==0||this.mode==3){
    Movement();
    AttackCheck();
  }else if (this.mode==1)SwordAttack();
  else if (this.mode==2) BushLift();
  Speak();
  if (hearts>0) timeout=.05;
  else SpinMove();
}
if ((washit||waspelt||exploded||wasshot)&&hearts>0){
  this.mode=0;
  throwcarry;
  hearts-=playerswordpower/2;
  this.mode=0;
  BounceBack();
  message I'll get you for that!;
  this.mcount=0;
}
